subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open external repair candidate, or close it and queue a fresh narrow fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but a closing PR is already open outside the target repository and is not maintainer-editable, so automation should not create a competing repair until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Replace or adopt the external candidate
options.body: Open a maintainer-owned replacement or otherwise adopt the existing fix shape, crediting the linked contributor work and adding the missing focused validation.

options.title: Close the external candidate and queue a new repair
options.body: Close the linked external PR as unusable for upstream landing, then allow a fresh narrow repair lane for this issue.

options.title: Keep both paused for owner review
options.body: Leave the issue and linked candidate open until a cron owner decides the exact minute-field semantics to support.

recommendation.title: Replace or adopt the external candidate
recommendation.body: Open a maintainer-owned replacement or otherwise adopt the existing fix shape, crediting the linked contributor work and adding the missing focused validation.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` introduced the default stagger behavior and is the strongest history signal for the cron stagger contract.
